academy.title: RESA Academy
academy.subtitle: Developing young players aged 6 to 15 in the USA and Africa — technique, tactics, physical and mental, in a demanding educational environment.
academy.missionText: Revealing and supporting young talents through a structured program that combines sporting excellence with personal development. Every player receives coaching adapted to their age and level.
academy.whyText: A professional club environment, a proven methodology and individualized follow-up. Our certified coaches support each player's sporting and educational journey.
academy.pillarsSubtitle: Our holistic approach develops the player as a whole — not just on the pitch.
academy.pillarTechText: Control, passing, dribbling, shooting — fundamentals built through smart repetition.
academy.pillarTacticText: Game reading, positioning, quick decision-making under match pressure.
academy.pillarPhysText: Coordination, speed, endurance — training tailored to each age group.
academy.pillarMentalText: Confidence, discipline, handling pressure — on and off the pitch.
academy.programsSubtitle: A progressive pathway adapted to every stage of the player's development.
academy.programDiscoveryText: Introduction, motor skills, fun. First contact with structured football.
academy.programDevelopmentText: Individual technique, game intelligence, first small-sided matches.
academy.programPerformanceText: Structured competition, collective tactics, advanced athletic preparation.
academy.programEliteText: High level, advanced scouting, preparation for the move to professional academies.
academy.pathwaySubtitle: Every step of progression is identified and supported by our team.
academy.regionsSubtitle: Our academies and programs are deployed in the United States and Africa.

ligue.subtitle: The official platform for school football in Côte d'Ivoire — a structured, educational competition open to all primary schools.
ligue.categoriesSubtitle: Each category is tailored to the age and level of the players, with its own schedule and standings.
ligue.catU7: First steps into football — basics, coordination, team spirit. CP and CE1 grades.
ligue.catU9: Technical and tactical development — small-sided matches. CE2 and CM1 grades.
ligue.catU11: Full competition — preparation for secondary level. CM2 grade.
ligue.rulesSubtitle: Official rules applied to all matches of the season.
ligue.rulePointsText: Win = 3 points · Draw = 1 point · Loss = 0 point.
ligue.ruleFormatText: Group championship, single or double round-robin. Format configurable per season and category.
ligue.ruleTiebreakText: 1. Head-to-head · 2. Goal difference · 3. Goals scored · 4. Fair-play · 5. Draw.
ligue.ruleForfeitText: Score 3-0 for the opponent. 48h notice expected before the match. Exclusion at the 3rd forfeit of the season.
ligue.rulePostponeText: A postponed match doesn't count in the standings. New date set within 15 days.
ligue.seasonText: January to June 2027 · 8 schools · 24 teams · 84 matches

resa.title: RESA Sport Academy
resa.subtitle: An Ivorian sports and educational organization that trains young players, scouts talents and structures school football across the country.
resa.missionText: To train happy, disciplined and competitive children through football. To give every young person — whatever their background — access to quality sports coaching, backed by a solid educational project.
resa.visionText: To make Côte d'Ivoire an African reference in football and educational training for youth aged 6 to 15, by structuring a national network of primary school leagues.
resa.valueRespectText: For the opponent, the referee, the teammate and the rules of the game.
resa.valueDisciplineText: Attendance, punctuality, constant effort — on the pitch and in class.
resa.valueTeamText: Learning to play together, win together, lose together.
resa.valueExcellenceText: Aiming for the best level, both athletic and academic, without compromise.
resa.activityAcademyText: Weekly training, technical development, age-adapted physical preparation.
resa.activityLeagueText: Organization of the official inter-school competition for the U7, U9 and U11 categories.
resa.activityScoutingText: Regular scouting sessions to identify the best profiles in the region.
resa.activityTrainingText: Certifying courses for supervisors from schools participating in the League.
resa.programSubtitle: The 2026-2027 season is organized around four key moments.
resa.programQ1Text: School registrations, team formation, initial scouting.
resa.programQ2Text: Intensive training, friendly matches, educator training.
resa.programQ3Text: First leg of the School League, initial player evaluation.
resa.programQ4Text: Second leg, finals per category, trophy ceremony and closing.
resa.staffSubtitle: A multidisciplinary team serving young players.
resa.staffSportText: Certified coaches, physical trainers, official referees trained by the federation.
resa.staffEduText: Specialized educators, academic follow-up, family support.
resa.staffMedText: Regular check-ups, injury prevention, strict safety protocols.
